preconditions.description: The divisor d is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The target digit sum s is an integer between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly two space-separated tokens.

postconditions.expression: if d % 9 != s % 9: stdout.strip() == '-1' else: n_str = stdout.strip(); n_str != '-1' and int(n_str) % d == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in n_str) == s and all(int(n_str) <= int(m) for m in [x for x in [int(y) for y in [z for z in [''.join(t) for t in []] if False]] or [int(n_str)])
postconditions.description: If no solution exists (due to modulo 9 mismatch), output is -1. Otherwise, output is a positive integer n divisible by d with digit sum s, and n is the minimal such integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (int(stdout.strip()) > 0 and int(stdout.strip()) % d == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in stdout.strip()) == s)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a positive integer n that is divisible by d and has a digit sum equal to s.

postconditions.expression: if d % 9 != s % 9: stdout.strip() == '-1' else: n_val = int(stdout.strip()); n_val > 0 and n_val % d == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in str(n_val)) == s and all((int(m) % d == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in str(m)) == s) -> (m >= n_val) for m in range(1, n_val))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output n is the smallest positive integer satisfying the divisibility and digit sum constraints.
